items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 31 at 3:05PM EDT until November 2 at 7:00AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 20 knots with gusts up to 30 knots and
seas 5 to 8 feet.

* WHERE...Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm
and Sebastian Inlet to Jupiter Inlet 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
